# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the recon playbook, template, methodology, or quality improvement.

## Scope and Safety

```text
Recon stage:
Scope assumption:
Stop condition:
Data handling:
```

## Quality Checks

- [ ] The change distinguishes recon leads from reportable vulnerabilities.
- [ ] Scope, rate limits, validation, and false positives are covered.
- [ ] Commands are conservative and include manual review notes where needed.
- [ ] Primary references are included when technical behavior changed.
- [ ] No live secrets, private data, target names, or unauthorized evidence are included.
- [ ] Markdown lint and local link checks pass.
